base_image.role: NVIDIA PyTorch container; the base the upstream recipe pins (recipe/scripts/config.sh BASE_IMAGE)
base_image.digest_note: The linux/arm64 manifest of nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3, resolved anonymously via nvcr.io's token + manifest endpoints (no NGC login required). The same digest is pinned in recipe/Dockerfile's FROM line.

upstream_recipe.license_note: The upstream recipe's own code, scripts and documentation are Apache-2.0 (upstream LICENSE, NOTICE, README and CREDITS.md all say so). This is NOT the AGPL-3.0-with-MIT-before-2026-09-07 license of the sibling MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks vLLM recipe; that license must not be applied here. The only MIT material in this recipe is TensorFold's notice for code written before v0.6.0, kept in attribution/LICENSE.MIT.
upstream_recipe.lock_note: Hashes of the vendored files exactly as published at the pinned commit; recipe/ is byte-identical to that commit's working tree (verified with diff -r, .git excluded). The upstream ships no Dockerfile: it builds its image from a shell heredoc inside recipe/scripts/prepare.sh (lines 177-189). This image folder materializes that heredoc as ./Dockerfile, the only file Petabridge writes.

petabridge_changes.dockerfile_origin: Materialized from recipe/scripts/prepare.sh lines 177-189 (the `docker build ... -f - patches <<'DOCKERFILE'` heredoc) at the pinned commit. Deviations are marked PETABRIDGE: in ./Dockerfile and are itemized in ./README.md (build boundary).

patch_set_label.label: tf.patches
patch_set_label.origin: recipe/scripts/config.sh image_hash(): sha256 over patches/*.patch plus IMAGE_EXTRAS, first 12 hex characters. Upstream passes it as a build argument; this image records it literally and asserts it at build time. It is the key the recipe's start.sh uses for its compiled-kernel cache.

tensorfold.license: Apache-2.0 from v0.6.0; code written before v0.6.0 keeps its MIT notice (attribution/LICENSE.MIT)
tensorfold.pin_note: Upstream installs the mutable tag v0.6.0 (recipe/scripts/config.sh TF_VERSION=v0.6.0). This repository pins source dependencies by immutable commit; c4646171139ee8a3c38103eaa1699dad226ec12b is the commit that annotated tag points at (git ls-remote, 2026-10-10).

python_packages.note: The upstream recipe's IMAGE_EXTRAS, kept as-is. These are version-pinned, not hash-pinned: an aarch64 wheel hash for av 18.1.0 and a single version inside the xgrammar range were not resolved here. Pin them by URL and checksum before enabling the build if the supply-chain bar for this image is to match the DeepSeek V4 image's.

runtime_models.note: Weights are NOT in the image. Pre-stage the pinned revisions into the host Hugging Face cache; the ranks mount it at /root/.cache/huggingface and run with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.

target.note: EXL3 routed experts at 4 bits a weight, BF16 elsewhere, ~176 GB. The recipe's default checkpoint since v1.3.3.

draft.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (research and evaluation; commercial licensing via Inco AI)
draft.optional: DRAFTER=mtp uses the target checkpoint's own MTP head and downloads no draft model; that mode serves one request at a time

base_model.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Z.AI Co., Ltd. The target checkpoint derives from it.

alternate.revision: not pinned by the recipe; revision empty in recipe/scripts/config.sh, so the Hub's main is used
alternate.note: Not the default. A byte-identical mirror of brandonmusic/GLM-5.3-Flash-tr3-4bpw, selectable with MODEL_ID. The required attribution notice is in attribution/SHAPLEYMCG-NOTICE.md.
